$comment: Generated by OpenClaw scripts/bridges/crew-facts.py from the live gateways, cron stores, crew-backends.jq and useragent.json. Never edit by hand: re-run it, then `bun run sync:zephyy`.
scope: agents: every active gateway config in the OpenClaw checkout. An agent on another node or under another user's gateway is not visible there, so its page card keeps its own copy and no model claim.

operators.name: agy (Antigravity)
operators.role: Drafts builds on a separate model family, and reviews when asked.

operators.name: Codex (Sol)
operators.role: Doshus's go-to reviewer: reads every change for its logic as well as its correctness, and builds when handed a lane.

operators.name: Claude Code
operators.role: Lead operator: builds, hardens and reviews, and takes second opinions from Fable, the Claude model it dispatches for the hard calls.

operators.name: Grok CLI
